purpose: Visual observation of publicly accessible road construction and landscape relationships. No photographic bytes used in any material or scene.

references.observations: Raised fractured asphalt crust, irregular undercut bites and rubble, pale gravel shoulder and graded deposits, faded lines, sparse cracks, road rising toward a crest, asymmetric rocky slope.
references.limitation: Documented damaged shoulder. Do not generalize severe washout over the whole everyday road.

references.observed_by: scene author and reference worker in cloud browser
references.observations: Pale graded fill feathers onto asphalt, partly dusty edge marking, narrow berms, organized machine ruts, shrubs beyond the worked strip, visibly rough mixed surface.
references.limitation: Fresh maintenance photograph; scene uses subtler traces rather than copying the equipment or tire tread.

references.observed_by: scene author and reference worker in cloud browser
references.observations: Narrow paved road, ragged edge line, bare fine roadside strip, twiggy rounded shrubs outside it, muted gray olive and ochre foliage, isolated rocky hill with lower open horizon.
references.limitation: Mojave Preserve, not a verified Victorville site. Joshua tree density is not adopted as a default.

scene_inferences: Representative high-desert earthworks, sediment sorting, shrub clustering and rock relief. Exact grading, erosion, vegetation and geology are authored, not surveyed.
